column_description: SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each security profile record.
CHAR(10) referencing DataFlow(RecordRegistry). Associates security details with a data flow.
INT referencing RiskManagement(RiskTrace). Links security measures to a risk record.
INT referencing DataProfile(ProfileTrace). Ties security info to a data profile.
CHAR(10) optional cross-reference historically called 'RecordID'.
encryptionstatus_enum. Possible values: (Full, Partial).
VARCHAR(40) describing the encryption method used (AES, RSA, etc.). Currently possible values: (SM4, Custom, RSA-2048, AES-256).

partialnone_enum enumerating data masking. Currently possible values: (Partial, Full).
VARCHAR(40) describing the anonymization methodology. Currently possible values: (T-Closeness, K-Anonymity, L-Diversity).
VARCHAR(40) describing pseudonymization status. Currently possible values: (Partial, Applied).
VARCHAR(40) specifying the authentication method (Basic, OAuth, SAML, etc.). Currently possible values: (Basic, SSO, MFA).
VARCHAR(45) specifying the authorization framework (RBAC, ABAC, etc.). Currently possible values: (ABAC, Custom, RBAC).
VARCHAR(30) describing the current access control status. Currently possible values: (Adequate, Strong, Weak).
VARCHAR(30) enumerating the API security posture. Currently possible values: (Vulnerable, Secure, Review Required).
VARCHAR(30) specifying the log integrity check mechanism. Currently possible values: (Pending, Passed, Failed).
SMALLINT indicating how many days audit logs are retained.
VARCHAR(35) describing the backup status. Currently possible values: (Current, Failed, Outdated).
VARCHAR(35) describing the disaster recovery status. Currently possible values: (Untested, Tested, Missing).
VARCHAR(35) storing the business continuity status or plan stage. Currently possible values: (Active, Outdated, Review Required).
